name: Zoho Desk
oneLiner: Multichannel help desk in the Zoho suite with ticketing, self-service portals, automation and the Zia AI assistant.
bestFor: Budget-conscious support teams, especially those already using Zoho CRM or other Zoho apps.

updates.text: Zoho launched its own Zia LLM plus Zia Agents, a no-code Agent Studio, an agent marketplace and an MCP server across its apps.
From 7 July 2026 Zia AI features such as sentiment analysis, auto tags and Zia notifications were extended to all paid Zoho Desk editions (Standard and above).

features: Tickets from email, phone, live chat, social media and web forms in one view
Zia AI: sentiment analysis, auto tags, reply suggestions, anomaly alerts
Answer Bot and self-service help center / portal
Assignment rules, SLAs, escalations and Blueprint workflows
CSAT surveys and agent performance reports
Integration with Zoho CRM, Zoho Analytics and other Zoho apps

pricing.text: Free plan for up to 3 agents. Paid plans start at $7/agent/month (Express, up to 5 agents), with Standard at $14/agent/month, billed annually.

notes: zoho.com could not be fetched; prices are the consensus of several 2026 third-party pricing guides that describe Zoho's published page, so a reviewer should confirm on zoho.com/desk/pricing.html (prices vary by region). Mercedes-Benz India is listed on casestudies.com's Zoho Desk page; I couldn't open Zoho's own story. The Zia LLM launch was suite-wide; Desk-specific availability of Zia Agents wasn't confirmed, so the review describes it as a Zoho-wide launch.
